title: Sign in
subtitle: Cashmere origin & quality registry system.
registerHint: Unverified records cannot sign in — the record must be verified first (UC-01, BR-12).

statusCheck.title: Check registration status
statusCheck.subtitle: Enter your username or email and password to view your registration status. Unverified records cannot sign in (UC-10 E3).
statusCheck.activeHint: The record is active. You can sign in now.
statusCheck.pendingHint: The registration awaits verification. You can sign in after the administrator/clerk approves it (BR-12).
statusCheck.rejectedHint: The registration was rejected. Contact the registry clerk if you have questions.
statusCheck.lockedHint: The account is temporarily locked. Lock duration/unlock is unresolved (BR-14, BR-15).

mock.roleHint: Other demo roles: clerk / quality / management / admin. Password: demo1234. Choosing a role fills in its username.
mock.supplierHint: Demo suppliers: batsaih (SP-001, active), dolon.sardag (SP-002, pending), damba.ganaa (SP-003, rejected). Password: demo1234. Email sign-in also works.
mock.note: Demo mode: username/email and password are checked. Real rules — lock after 5 failed attempts (NFR-11) with an unresolved lock duration/unlock (BR-14, BR-15) and an 8-hour token lifetime (NFR-08).
mock.accounts: batsaih, clerk, quality, management, admin · password demo1234

blocked.title: Sign-in unavailable
blocked.hint: An unverified record cannot be used to sign in (UC-10 E3).
blocked.pendingBody: The registration awaits verification. Sign-in becomes possible once the administrator/clerk approves it (BR-12).
